criteria.normalization: strip comments; string literals->S; numbers->N; non-keyword identifiers->ID; whitespace ignored (token stream)
criteria.link: identical normalized before OR Jaccard(4-gram token shingles)>=0.85; single-linkage union-find
criteria.keep_policy: cluster with a single before shape, single after shape AND single string-preserving shape: keep 1; otherwise: keep up to 2, prefer non-template sources (v0.1/mk/sam over bill), then distinct normalized-after (fix diversity), then distinct string-preserving before (L2)
